Based on the FY2024 10-K income statement data, Microsoft's gross profit and gross margin for fiscal year 2024 can be calculated as follows:

- Revenue: $245,122 million [DOC-1]
- Cost of revenue: $74,114 million [DOC-1]
- Gross profit = $245,122M − $74,114M = $171,008 million
- Gross margin % = $171,008M / $245,122M ≈ 69.76%

Both periods (FY2024 and the FY2023 comparative) are presented on the same fiscal-year basis (year ended June 30) within the same 10-K, so the FY2024 figures used here are directly comparable and require no adjustment.

ANSWER: Gross profit of approximately $171,008 million, representing a gross margin of approximately 69.8% of revenue ($171,008M / $245,122M).
